name: assay
description: End-to-end testing and LLM benchmarking for your product, with your own Claude. /assay:connect studies the product and sets it all up in one prompt: journeys that check what the app actually saved, a quality gate on every pull request, a benchmark of its AI features. Then /assay:explore lets an agent loose on it, /assay:bench compares models and prompts, /assay:fix fixes a failed gate.
